title: White Wares of Northern China
version: Shipwrecked: Tang Treasures and Monsoon Winds, Smithsonian, pp. 200–207
lineage: Full chapter in a 2010 exhibition catalogue. Dating/attribution are the archaeologist’s interpretation; the 2010 book date applies to awareness of the isolated ancient branch.

passages.note: Identifies isolated late-Shang white stoneware experiments and describes Xing whiteware among the ninth-century Belitung cargo.
